name: Takachiho
parentage: Selected from a native Zairai population.
description: A classic cultivar specific to the regions in Kyushu that specialize in 'Kamairicha' or pan-fired green tea. It is prized for its ability to withstand the high heat of pan-firing, producing a green tea with a beautiful nutty and roasted aroma ('kama-ka') that is very different from the vegetal notes of steamed Sencha.
plantType: Medium-sized, robust bush adapted to pan-firing (Camellia sinensis var. sinensis).
environment: Thrives in the warm climate of southern Kyushu, particularly Miyazaki, the heart of Kamairicha production.
processing: the leaves are fired in a hot iron pan or rotating drum
